{{Update |title1 = v1.2.1 |image1 = DuckHuntEvent.png |release_date = 23 April 2022 |minor_updates = v1.2.1a (23 April 2022) |feed_title = Community-Based Changes |previous_update = [[V1.2.0|Duck Hunt Update]] |next_update = [[v1.2.2]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.2.1''' is the thirty-fifth update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 23rd of April 2022. It added the {{Color|Other|Plushie}} [[Commander]] and a few minor changes. This version encompassed two updates, the main v1.2.1 (released 23 April 2022) and the minor v1.2.1a (released the same day as v1.2.1, 23 April 2022). ==Additions== *New [[Codes|code]] obtained by purchasing a [[Commander Plush (Level 1)|Commander Plush]] **Code is unique for each [[Commander Plush (Level 1)|Commander Plush]] bought **Gives {{Color|Other|Plushie}} [[Commander]] skin ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Engineer]] buffed. **Sentries can no longer collide with enemies. **Statistical changes: ***'''Level 4''' ****Sentries now gain a shield which protects them from stuns when it is active. *Extended [[Duck Hunt Event#Hunting Season|Hunting Season]] to 9 ranks. **Rewards: ***Rank 8 - {{Color|DuckHunt|Ducky}} [[Farm]] ***Rank 9 - {{Color|DuckHunt|Ducky}} [[Engineer]] *[[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode wave layout changed. *[[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode triumph bonus changed from {{Gem|50}} to {{Gem|150}}. *[[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]] health increased from 700,000 to 1,200,000. *Reworked [[codes]] menu and system. *Added announcements board to the lobby. *New {{Color|Eclipse|Eclipse}} [[Commander]] voicelines. *[[Farm]] and [[Military Base]] can no longer be targeted by enemies with their attacks. *Fixed unit ranged damage not increasing the Total Damage counter. *Fixed Total Spent counter. *Fixed [[Engineer]] being able to build sentries in its red range. *Multiple typos corrected. **Fixed ''Making'' being misspelt as ''Makining'' on Wave 27 of [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. **Fixed ''a'' being misspelt as ''an'' on Wave 13 of [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. **Fixed [[Mortar]]'s Level 5 upgrade name ''Nuclear Devastation'' being misspelt as ''Nuclear Devistation''. **Fixed [[Farm]]'s Level 2 upgrade name ''Wheat Farm'' being misspelt as ''Wheat Farm,''. :In '''v1.2.1a''': *Fixed not getting {{Color|DuckHunt|Ducky}} [[Engineer]] after purchasing Rank 9 with robux. *Fixed being able to purchase Rank 9 multiple times. *Fixed all maps being very dark. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} DuckHuntEvent.png {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} Duck Hunt 2022 icon.png {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} PlushieCommanderPI.jpg {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} File:Commander Literally Becomes a Plushie - Tower Defense Simulator }} ==Official Update Log== ''NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate as this is transcribed from the game's in-game update log. Several things may be incorrect and there may be things that are missing.'' ===v1.2.1=== {{UpdateLog| {{UpdateBanner|v1.2.1Banner.png|Community-Based Changes}} {{UpdateH1|NOO! Pre-orders will begin on 4/22/20222!
{{Color|Neutral|For more info, checked{{sic}} the pinned post on our Twitter! @Paradoxum_games}}}} {{UpdateH1|🔨 Community-Based Changes}} {{UpdateWhiteText|We hear you all out! A list of things we've changed is included below.}} {{UpdateH1|📜Update Log:}} {{UpdateH3|🛡️[[Engineer]] Sentry Shield (!)}} *Protects [[Engineer|Engie]]'s sentries from getting 1 shotted! {{UpdateH3|💎Increased [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] Triumph Reward (!)}} *250 Gems Per Win *Removed 1 "[[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]]" *Buffed [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]] Health {{UpdateH3|📋Added Announcements Board to Lobby}} {{UpdateH3|⌨️Revised Redeemable [[Codes]] Menu + System}} {{UpdateH3|🦆Extended "[[Duck Hunt Event#Hunting Season|Duck Hunting]]" Season}} *Ducky [[Farm]] *Ducky [[Engineer]] {{UpdateH3|🧸Added Plushie [[Commander]] Skin}} *Exclusive Skin {{UpdateH3|🔧Bug Fixes}} *[[Units|Unit]] Damage Adds to "Total Damage" Stat *Fixed "Total Spent" Stat *Fixed "Eclipse" [[Commander]] Voices }} {{UpdateNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:v1.2.1}} [[Category:Modern Updates]]
